normalization.name: trailing-null-padding-removal
normalization.reason: The strict importer refuses any FoundationFoods entry that is not an object. The 32 nulls are trailing padding carrying no food row, so they are dropped before import; the importer itself is used unmodified.
normalization.rule: Drop the contiguous run of null entries at the tail of FoundationFoods and keep entries 0-362 in their original order, unchanged.
assertions: every entry is either a plain object or null (0 entries of any other type)
the 363 object entries occupy the contiguous prefix 0-362
the 32 omitted entries are exactly the trailing run 363-394 and every one of them is null
each retained entry is the identical value at the identical index in the raw list (verified by identity and by JSON round-trip)

output.form: bare JSON list of the 363 retained objects
output.serialization: JSON.stringify(rawDocument.FoundationFoods.slice(0, 363)), UTF-8, no added whitespace, no trailing newline
